title: Extend Design App Filters to Piece Connection Port
prompt: Extend the DesignToolbarFilters to include piece, connection, and port toggles. Currently the filters are non-functional (pressed=true, onPressedChange=noop). Replace with URL state persistence following the Type app pattern
summary: Extended Design app toolbar filters with piece, connection, and port toggles using URL state persistence. Filters control rendering visibility in diagram (nodes/edges hidden) and 3D scene. Added PieceIcon, i18n entries, filter context/provider/hook. Fixed pre-existing merge conflicts in Sketchpad.tsx. All 12 unit tests pass, zero TS errors.
